content.title: Where to Watch ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 Online
content.text: Skip to main content Where to Watch ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 Online The hit series returns on April 12 after a four-year hiatus. Here’s where to stream new episodes HBO If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Rolling Stone may receive an affiliate commission. After a four-year hiatus, Euphoria is back for a third season. The new season of this HBO hit will pick up (fittingly) four years after the events of Season Two, with the characters now out of high school, navigating adulthood. At a Glance: Where to Watch Euphoria Season 3 Stream on HBO Max (free trial through DirecTV) Release date: Sunday, April 12 Since the Season Two finale, cast members including Zendaya, Jacob Elordi, Hunter Schafer, and Sydney Sweeney have skyrocketed to new levels of stardom, but they’ll be back for the show’s new season. Some new faces will also join this season, including stars like Rosalía, Sharon Stone, Danielle Deadwyler, and Natasha Lyonne. Euphoria Season Three premieres on Sunday, April 12 at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT. Where to Watch Euphoria Season 3 Online Like the previous two seasons, Euphoria Season Three will be available to stream exclusively on HBO Max. HBO Max offers three subscription tiers. All of them will let you watch new episodes of Euphoria when they’re released and all past episodes. Basic with Ads: $10.99/month or $109.99/yearThe most affordable HBO Max plan is Basic with Ads, which costs $10.99 a month or $109.99 for a discounted annual subscription. This plan lets you stream on up to two devices at once with a maximum resolution of 1080p. This plan does not include sports livestreams or 4K streaming, and you’ll be served ads during all content. Standard: $18.49/month or $184.99/yearHBO Max’s Standard plan removes ads and gives you access to live sports streams. It also lets you download up to 30 titles for offline viewing. There’s still a two-device cap on simultaneous streaming, and you can’t stream in 4K. Premium: $22.99/month or $229.99/yearThe best HBO Max plan is its Premium tier, which costs $22.99 a month or $229.99 a year. This one lets you stream on up to four devices at once, and you can watch certain content in 4K resolution with Dolby Atmos audio. Premium also lets you download up to 100 titles to watch without WiFi or cell service. How to Get HBO Max Free Trial for Euphoria Season 3 One downside with HBO Max is that it doesn’t offer a free trial. However, you can get access to HBO Max for free with a free trial to DirecTV’s Premier streaming package or its MyEntertainment Genre Pack. DirecTV offers a five-day free trial on both of these plans, nd they include HBO Max at no additional cost. Read more about this HBO Max free trial hack here.
